item.title: The Staff+ Operating Model: a recursive mining of the technical leadership canon
item.description: I went deep on Will Larson, Tanya Reilly, Camille Fournier, Charity Majors and the fifteen authors they recommend, then distilled the invariant operating model for Senior SWE → Tech Lead → Staff/Principal. Here is the shared framework, the concrete playbooks, and the honest watch-outs — with the exact reading order if you want the whole set.

item.title: Building Luffy: a PR review agent you can audit
item.description: A comment-triggered PR review control plane. Hermes Agent, OpenRouter, Claude Opus 5, and a hub memory that actually grows. Built it on a real Odoo bug, captured the full agentic loop, and got a REQUEST CHANGES the code earned. Here is the system, the numbers, and a slice of the trace.

item.title: Memori: The Recursive Design of Agent Memory
item.description: Agent memory is not a storage problem. It is a retrieval problem -- and the architecture of Memori follows directly from that shift in framing. This post walks through the conceptual core: why memory is really three problems, what each design decision reduces to, and why the system stores rules about how to use itself.

item.title: Building Persistent Memory for AI Agents: Architecture Decisions in Memori
item.description: A deep dive into the engineering decisions behind Memori -- a persistent memory system for AI coding agents built on Rust, SQLite, and fastembed. Covers hybrid search with RRF, access decay scoring, cosine deduplication, and why I deliberately chose brute-force over indexing.

item.title: Designing CLI Tools for AI Agents: Lessons from Building Memori
item.description: A practitioner's guide to designing command-line tools that AI coding agents can use effectively -- covering output modes, error design, behavioral snippets, and the subtle art of making machines help themselves.

item.title: The AI-Augmented Developer Playbook: Architect, Delegate, Validate
item.description: A practical playbook for shifting from code-producing craftsman to AI-orchestrating architect, using abstract thinking, pattern libraries, and rigorous validation to ship higher-leverage systems.
